mapper.sql: p.id, p.travel_plan_id, p.created_by_member_id, p.title, p.selection_type, p.result_visibility, p.close_type, p.deadline_at, p.status, p.close_reason, p.closed_at, p.created_at, p.updated_at, m.display_name AS created_by_display_name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_plan_polls (travel_plan_id, created_by_member_id, title, selection_type, result_visibility, close_type, deadline_at, status) VALUES (#{travelPlanId}, #{createdByMemberId}, #{title}, #{selectionType}, #{resultVisibility}, #{closeType}, #{deadlineAt}, #{status})
INSERT INTO travel_plan_poll_options (poll_id, content, display_order) VALUES (#{pollId}, #{content}, #{displayOrder})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM travel_plan_polls p LEFT JOIN travel_plan_members m ON m.id = p.created_by_member_id WHERE p.travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} AND p.status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY p.created_at ASC, p.id ASC

SELECT
FROM travel_plan_polls p LEFT JOIN travel_plan_members m ON m.id = p.created_by_member_id WHERE p.travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} AND p.status = 'CLOSED' ORDER BY p.closed_at DESC, p.id DESC
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS poll_count FROM travel_plan_polls WHERE travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} GROUP BY status
SELECT option_id FROM travel_plan_poll_vote_selections WHERE vote_id = #{voteId} ORDER BY option_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_plan_poll_votes v JOIN travel_plan_members m ON m.id = v.member_id WHERE v.poll_id = #{pollId} AND m.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM travel_plan_poll_votes WHERE poll_id = #{pollId})
mapper.update: UPDATE travel_plan_polls SET status = 'CLOSED', close_reason = #{closeReason}, closed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM travel_plan_polls WHERE travel_plan_id = #{travelPlanId} AND status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY id ASC
